messages.content: You are a helpful personal assistant operating on the user's laptop. Answer the user's task directly. Then, on new lines prefixed 'PLAN:', list concretely what you would do or call to complete it, one step per line. Keep the whole reply under 120 words.
User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Here's a short, professional apology email draft:

**Subject:** Apology — [brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" / "Meeting absence"]

Hi [Name],

I'm sorry for [specific issue — e.g., "missing yesterday's deadline on the Q3 report" / "not being able to attend today's stand-up"]. It was [brief reason if appropriate — e.g., "an oversight on my part" / "an unexpected conflict"], and I take full responsibility.

I've [corrective action — e.g., "submitted the report this morning" / "reviewed the notes and will follow up with questions by EOD"]. Please let me know if there's anything else I can do to make this right.

Best,  
[Your Name]

---

PLAN: Ask user for the specific situation and colleague's name to personalize the draft  
PLAN: Offer 2-3 tone variations (formal, casual, brief) based on their relationship  
PLAN: Suggest a subject line that's clear but not alarming  
PLAN: Remind user to send promptly and follow through on any promised action
